subject: Mutual Action Plan: Pilot milestones, credits, and conversion pricing for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and pilot credit proposal for Acme Analytics

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As promised, attaching a first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed pilot credit package so your team can validate latency/cost on your end. High-level proposal: 

- Pilot scope: 4-week POC focused on search reranking + chat assistant (up to 20k daily requests)
- Pilot credit: 200k token credit applied to your account to cover inference costs during the POC (ledger entry, no charge)
- Success milestones (suggested):
  * Week 1: integration + smoke tests (SDK + network)
  * Week 2: 10k queries/day throughput validation + latency baseline
  * Week 3: quality evals on sample prompt sets (pass threshold 85% on NIST-style metric)
  * Week 4: ramp test and conversion decision
- Conversion pricing guidance: standard pay-as-you-go, or a committed tier if Acme wants predictable unit economics (I include tiered rates in the MAP)

I'm sharing MAP-draft-v1.pdf and a strawman SOW (SOW-acme-pilot.docx). Can you confirm your procurement timeline and whether procurement needs a PO or electronic invoice to start?

Next steps I recommend: review MAP, confirm start date by Friday, and I'll extend the pilot credit window if we need an extra week to accommodate procurement.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Sergio —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. A couple of clarifying Qs from our side before we loop in procurement: 

1) The 200k token credit — can that be extended to cover a potential 6-week pilot if we need extra time to validate at scale?
2) On conversion pricing: can you share the committed monthly minimums tied to the lower unit price? Lina will need that to evaluate budget impact.
3) Compliance: can you share SOC 2 and data retention descriptions so our security team can greenlight?

If you can address those we'll get procurement in the thread. I can be available next Tuesday for a short call.

Jordan

Jordan —

Appreciate the questions. Short answers and proposed MAP adjustments below — looping in Marissa (AE lead) and Karthik (Solutions/SE) to help land the procurement and technical checks.

1) Pilot credit extension: yes — we can extend the 200k token credit to cover up to 6 weeks. If procurement pushback means a delayed start, we can move the start window up to 30 days from sign.

2) Conversion pricing (strawman):
   - Pay-as-you-go: $0.006 / 1k tokens (no commit)
   - Committed 6-month: $0.0045 / 1k tokens with a $15k/month minimum
   - Committed 12-month: $0.003 / 1k tokens with a $25k/month minimum and priority capacity

   We are willing to offer a one-time conversion discount of 10% on the first 3 months if Acme signs within 30 days of pilot completion.

3) Compliance docs: Karthik will attach SOC 2 summary and the data retention policy.

Proposed MAP (dates assume start on Mon Jul 20):
- Jul 20: pilot kickoff (integration window)
- Jul 27: throughput baseline complete
- Aug 3: quality signoff + evaluation report due
- Aug 10: ramp test + final decision; internal signoff by Acme

If procurement needs a PO upfront we can accept a PO that references the SOW and apply the pilot credit once the PO is received. Marissa — can you confirm finance acceptability?

Thanks — I can join your Tuesday call.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the clear MAP. Procurement notes / redlines: 

- We can issue a PO referencing the SOW. Pilot credit needs to be visible on the invoice (line item) and applied before the pilot start.
- If Acme commits to a 12-month reserved capacity at the conclusion of the pilot (minimum $25k/month) we request a 15% first-year discount instead of the 10% one-time conversion discount. This needs to be explicit in the MSA/SOW redlines.
- We require SOC 2 Type II report or an attested summary and a signed data processing addendum (DPA) prior to production traffic.
- Please provide an estimated invoice schedule and a sample PO-to-invoice mapping for our AP team.

Also — can you add a clause in the MAP limiting the pilot to non-production data or confirm the handling of PII in logs? Our security team flagged log retention during the demo.

Lina Gomez
Procurement Director | Acme Analytics

Lina —

Thanks for the redlines — very reasonable. Quick confirmations and next steps from finance/legal side: 

- PO flow: we can accept a PO referencing the SOW. We will apply the 200k token pilot credit as an invoice credit line item; I'll send a sample invoice mapping to procurement by EOD.
- Discount: Redwood can accept the 15% first-year discount if Acme executes a 12-month reserved capacity at $25k/month. We will reflect this in the MSA redline and the SOW.
- Compliance: Karthik attached SOC 2 summary and the DPA template in the Drive link; we can provide SOC 2 Type II within 5 business days to your security contact once we get the signed NDA/MSA.
- PII/logs: pilot will default to redacted logs and a 30-day retention unless you request otherwise in writing; will include in SOW.

Action items:
- Sergio: send updated MAP + MSA redlines including the 12-mo reserved capacity incentive and the PO/invoice example.
- Lina: confirm PO format and send sample PO number when ready.
- Jordan: confirm kickoff date (we proposed Jul 20).
